title: Pooling Helps, Learned Weighting Hurts In-Context: Decomposing Group Attention
abstract: arXiv:2610.01831v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Group attention, introduced by the time series forecasting model Chronos-2, attends over the variates of a group at a fixed patch index and serves both multivariate (MV) and in-context learning (ICL) forecasting. Rather than evaluating this cross-variate attention design as a whole, we ask which part of the mechanism earns the benefit and probe its applicability to both MV and ICL regimes. By editing the attention matrix $\alpha$ at inference we separate the two pathways a head comprises: V/O, which projects a weighted summary of the group, and Q/K, which decides the weights. Uniform pooling (V/O without any Q/K weighting) is positive on 18 of our 20 sensor-network configurations, while the learned weighting (Q/K) splits by group type: its contribution is positive or negligible for MV, but materially degrades 8 of the 10 sensor-network ICL configurations, leaving 4 of them worse than univariate inference. translated_title: 池化有益，学习式加权损害上下文学习：对组注意力的分解
translated_abstract: 组注意力由时间序列预测模型Chronos-2引入，在固定的补丁索引处对组内各变量进行注意力计算，并同时服务于多变量（MV）和上下文学习（ICL）预测。我们不将这种跨变量注意力设计作为一个整体来评估，而是探究该机制中哪一部分真正带来了收益，并检验其在MV和ICL两种模式下的适用性。通过在推理阶段编辑注意力矩阵α，我们将注意力头所包含的两条路径分离开来：V/O路径负责投影组的加权摘要，Q/K路径则决定权重。均匀池化（即不含任何Q/K加权的V/O）在我们20个传感器网络配置中的18个上产生积极效果；而学习式加权（Q/K）的作用则按组类型分化：其对MV的贡献为正面或可忽略，但在10个传感器网络ICL配置中的8个上造成实质性退化，其中4个配置甚至比单变量推理更差。通过隔离……（原文截断）
tldr: 通过分解Chronos-2的组注意力机制发现，其收益主要来自均匀池化（V/O路径），而学习式Q/K加权虽对多变量预测有益或影响可忽略，却会严重损害传感器网络的上下文学习预测（10个配置中8个性能退化，4个甚至劣于单变量推理）。
en_tdlr: Decomposing Chronos-2's group attention reveals its benefit comes from uniform pooling (V/O), while learned Q/K weighting, though positive or negligible for multivariate forecasting, substantially degrades sensor-network in-context learning—hurting 8 of 10 configurations and leaving 4 worse than univariate inference.
